svg.title: Harmony 600, front face
svg.desc: Outline drawing of the Harmony 600 front face, one shape per button. Its shapes are traced from the product documentation and its lettering and symbols are drawn from a photograph. 54 buttons, of which 36 carry a measured scan code. Its screen is not a touch surface: the keys flanking it are how its labels are reached. Every fill and stroke reads a custom property, so the interface decides the colours; nothing here is coloured in.
